description: This file defines a Mongoose schema and model for managing application deployment data within a MongoDB database. It specifies the structure, indexes, and default values for app deployment documents, enabling CRUD operations and project-specific data resolution.

classes.name: appDeploymentSchema
classes.description: A Mongoose schema defining the structure of app deployment documents in MongoDB.

methods.name: model('AppDeployment', appDeploymentSchema)
methods.description: Creates and exports the Mongoose model for app deployments based on the defined schema.
